signals.summary: The W3C opened a 90-day public comment period (closing 14 Sep 2026) to formalize llms.txt as a web standard, building on the Answer.AI Sept 2024 spec, with rules like llms.txt precedence for AI-classified crawlers. Adoption is ~8.7% of top-1,000 sites and higher among docs sites; Princeton GEO-bench (May 2026) reported ~23% more AI citations for sites with structured llms.txt. This is a category-shaping discoverability signal for any documentation/help-centre platform - directly relevant to Document360's share-of-search and AI-answer exposure.
